from matplotlib.widgets import SpanSelector

ax.plot([10, 20], [10, 20])
xlim_before = ax.get_xlim()
ss = SpanSelector(ax, print, "horizontal", interactive=True)
xlim_after = ax.get_xlim()
print("xlim before:", xlim_before)
print("xlim after :", xlim_after)
assert xlim_before == xlim_after, "xlim changed by creating interactive SpanSelector"
print("OK: xlim unchanged")

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
import matplotlib.widgets as mw

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot([10, 20], [10, 20])
fig.canvas.draw()
print("dataLim after draw:", ax.dataLim)

# who calls update_datalim?
orig_udl = type(ax).update_datalim
def udl(self, xys, updatex=True, updatey=True):
    import traceback
    stack = [f"{f.name}:{f.lineno}" for f in traceback.extract_stack()[-4:-1]]
    print(f"  update_datalim xys={xys} updatex={updatex} updatey={updatey} via {stack}")
    return orig_udl(self, xys, updatex, updatey)
type(ax).update_datalim = udl

# trace SpanSelector internals
orig_seh = mw.SpanSelector._setup_edge_handle
def seh(self, props):
    print(f"_setup_edge_handle: rect x={self._rect.get_x()} w={self._rect.get_width()} "
          f"extents={self.extents} dataLim={self.ax.dataLim}")
    orig_seh(self, props)
    print(f"  after: dataLim={self.ax.dataLim} handle pos={self._edge_handles.positions}")
mw.SpanSelector._setup_edge_handle = seh

orig_na = mw.SpanSelector.new_axes
def na(self, ax):
    orig_na(self, ax)
    print(f"new_axes done: rect x={self._rect.get_x()} w={self._rect.get_width()} dataLim={self.ax.dataLim}")
mw.SpanSelector.new_axes = na

ss = mw.SpanSelector(ax, print, "horizontal", interactive=True)
print("final dataLim:", ax.dataLim, "xlim:", ax.get_xlim())

import matplotlib

import matplotlib.widgets as mw

ax.plot([10, 20], [10, 20])

orig_tlh = mw.ToolLineHandles.__init__
def tlh(self, ax, positions, direction, line_props=None, useblit=True):
    caller = traceback.extract_stack()[-2]
    print(f"ToolLineHandles INIT positions={positions} (caller {caller.name}:{caller.lineno})")
    orig_tlh(self, ax, positions, direction, line_props, useblit)
mw.ToolLineHandles.__init__ = tlh

def seh(self, props):
    print(f"_setup_edge_handle ENTER: extents={self.extents} rect=({self._rect.get_x()}, {self._rect.get_width()})")
    orig_seh(self, props)
    print(f"_setup_edge_handle EXIT: handle pos={self._edge_handles.positions} dataLim={self.ax.dataLim}")
mw.SpanSelector._setup_edge_handle = seh

ss = mw.SpanSelector(ax, print, "horizontal", interactive=True)
print("FINAL: extents:", ss.extents, "dataLim:", ax.dataLim, "xlim:", ax.get_xlim())
